name: floating-card-gallery
title: Floating Card Gallery
description: A responsive grid (1/2/3 columns) of dark glassy article cards - image, title, excerpt, author avatar, category badge - floating in 3D over a purple gradient with drifting particles. The whole grid tilts toward the mouse, hovering lifts a card with a violet glow, and clicking opens an overlay with the full text, tags and a call-to-action link.
darkMode: always dark (own slate/purple palette); change backgroundClassName / accentColor to fit a brand
mainProps: cards: {title, description, image, fullDescription?, avatar?, author?, category?, tags?, href?}[], backgroundClassName, accentColor, maxCards (6), ctaLabel, tilt (degrees, 0 = flat), className
notes: Section is min-h-screen by default (override with className). Heavily fixed from the 21st.dev original, which would not build: added types + 'use client', removed Math.random() in render (hydration mismatch), defined the missing float keyframes, Tailwind v4 opacity syntax, tilt via motion values, reduced-motion, Escape to close, and the CTA is now a real link (href) instead of a dead button.
